checks.outcome: By day 5 you'll be able to build, deploy, and calibrate an inference proxy that dynamically routes prompts between cheap and frontier LLMs.
By day 5 you'll be able to set up a gateway that routes prompts across several models, add failover and difficulty-based routing, and tune it against a cost budget.

By day 5 you'll be able to put a gateway in front of several models, route each prompt by rules, health, predicted difficulty or a cheap-first cascade, and tune the cutoffs against cost and quality numbers you track.

why: B offers the gentlest progression and most realistic beginner tasks, while C packs more implementation into short sittings and assumes an unexplained regional setting.
